sources.citation: Stanley Schachter (1968). Obesity and Eating. Science.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1968) in Science establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: C. Peter Herman, Janet Polivy (2008). External cues in the control of food intake in humans: The sensory-normative distinction. Physiology & Behavior.
sources.notes: Refines Schachter's externality hypothesis by demonstrating that portion-size and social-normative cues robustly govern intake across body-weight groups.

sources.citation: Janet Polivy, C. Peter Herman (2017). Restrained Eating and Food Cues: Recent Findings and Conclusions. Current Obesity Reports.
sources.notes: Synthesizes modern behavioral and neurocognitive research on chronic dietary restraint, cue reactivity, and environmental portion-size effects.

sources.citation: Everett C. Hughes (1958). When Prophecy Fails.Leon Festinger , Henry W. Riecken , Stanley Schachter. American Journal of Sociology.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (1958) in American Journal of Sociology extending the foundational findings.

sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (1951) in American Journal of Sociology extending the foundational findings.
